items.title: Microsoft To Depreciate VBScript In Windows Warns Developers To Adapt Their Projects
items.description: Microsoft has officially announced a multi-phase plan to deprecate VBScript in Windows, a move that signals a significant shift for developers, particularly those working with Visual Basic for Applications (VBA). items.title: Cursor AI Code Editor Flaw Enables Silent Code Execution via Malicious Repositories
items.description: A security weakness has been disclosed in the artificial intelligence (AI)-powered code editor Cursor that could trigger code execution when a maliciously crafted repository is opened using the program. The issue stems from the fact that an out-of-the-box security setting is disabled by default, opening the door for attackers to run arbitrary code on users' computers with their privileges. "
